title: Head – Outreach (Admissions Department)
description:
Head – Outreach (Admissions Department)

**Company:** Harsha Institutions  
**Location:** Nelamangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Department:** Admissions – Outreach  
**Reporting To:** Director – Admissions / Secretary  
**Salary:** ₹1,00,000–₹1,50,000 per month

Job Summary

Harsha Institutions is looking for a dynamic, strategic, and results-oriented Head – Outreach to lead student outreach, regional expansion, and institutional relationship management across **South India**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing a strong student recruitment network across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana; establishing partnerships with schools, colleges, educational consultants, and other recruitment channels; generating quality student leads; and supporting the achievement of admission targets across Harsha Institutions.

The ideal candidate should have an extensive professional network across South India, excellent leadership and business development capabilities, and a proven track record of developing regional outreach operations and delivering measurable student recruitment results.

The selected candidate will report to the Director – Admissions and work closely with the Secretary and institutional leadership to expand Harsha Institutions' regional presence and admissions network.

Key Responsibilities1. South India Outreach Strategy and Expansion

* Develop and implement comprehensive outreach strategies across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.
* Establish a strong and sustainable student recruitment network throughout South India.
* Identify new geographical markets, student recruitment opportunities, and potential institutional partners.
* Prepare state-wise, district-wise, institution-wise, and course-wise outreach plans.
* Set measurable targets for outreach activities, lead generation, applications, and student enrolments.
* Develop long-term strategies to strengthen the institution's presence across South India.

2. Institutional Networking and Relationship Management

* Establish and maintain strong relationships with school managements, principals, PU colleges, degree colleges, educational consultants, career counsellors, and student recruitment partners.
* Build and manage an extensive network of institutional contacts and recruitment associates across South India.
* Develop strategic partnerships that generate consistent student enquiries and admissions.
* Conduct regular visits to key cities, districts, and educational institutions to expand the recruitment network.
* Identify and establish new collaboration opportunities with educational institutions and relevant organisations.

3. Student Lead Generation and Admission Growth

* Develop multiple lead generation channels through school and college outreach, educational partnerships, career guidance programmes, education fairs, and regional promotional activities.
* Coordinate with the Admissions Department to ensure effective follow-up and conversion of outreach-generated leads.
* Monitor leads, applications, counselling progress, and confirmed admissions across all assigned regions.
* Identify opportunities to increase student enrolments from different states and geographical markets.
* Implement strategies to improve lead quality, admission conversion rates, and recruitment partner productivity.

4. Team Leadership and Regional Management

* Lead and supervise outreach managers, regional coordinators, field executives, and recruitment representatives.
* Establish state-wise and region-wise responsibilities, targets, and performance expectations.
* Develop an effective reporting and monitoring system for regional outreach operations.
* Train and guide the team in networking, relationship management, institutional presentations, and student recruitment.
* Monitor team performance and take corrective action to achieve assigned targets.

5. Outreach Campaigns and Institutional Representation

* Plan and coordinate education fairs, career guidance sessions, school seminars, college visits, campus visits, and student awareness programmes.
* Represent Harsha Institutions at regional educational events and student recruitment activities.
* Coordinate with Marketing and Digital Marketing teams to implement state-specific promotional campaigns.
* Ensure effective execution and follow-up of all outreach initiatives.
* Strengthen institutional visibility and brand presence across South India.

6. Market Research and Business Development

* Analyse regional education trends, competitor activities, course demand, and student preferences.
* Identify emerging student recruitment markets and recommend expansion strategies.
* Assess the effectiveness of existing recruitment channels and develop new partnership opportunities.
* Monitor regional performance and recommend improvements to increase enrolments.
* Develop sustainable outreach channels that support long-term institutional growth.

7. Reporting and Management Coordination

* Report to the Director – Admissions and coordinate with the Secretary on strategic outreach initiatives.
* Submit weekly and monthly reports covering regional visits, institutional partnerships, leads generated, and admissions achieved.
* Present state-wise performance against approved targets.
* Prepare outreach budgets, travel plans, recruitment proposals, and regional expansion plans for management approval.
* Provide regular updates on market opportunities, team performance, and operational challenges.

8. Interdepartmental Coordination

* Work closely with the Director – Admissions, Admission Managers, Counsellors, Marketing, and Digital Marketing teams.
* Coordinate with Principals, Deans, and Heads of Departments to promote academic programmes and institutional facilities.
* Ensure that all outreach activities communicate accurate programme details, eligibility criteria, facilities, and admission policies.
* Support the achievement of overall institutional admission targets through effective regional recruitment networks.

Educational Qualification

No specific educational qualification is mandatory.

Candidates will be evaluated primarily on their professional experience, established industry network, leadership capabilities, regional market knowledge, and demonstrated achievements in outreach and student recruitment.

Experience Required

* Extensive experience in educational outreach, admissions, student recruitment, institutional marketing, business development, or a related field.
* Proven experience in developing and managing recruitment networks across South India.
* Demonstrated success in establishing partnerships with schools, colleges, educational consultants, and student recruitment associates.
* Experience in leading regional teams and managing large-scale outreach operations.
* A strong professional network across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.
* Proven ability to generate student enquiries, convert leads into admissions, and achieve enrolment targets.
* Experience in higher education or multi-institution educational groups will be an advantage.

Required Skills

* Exceptional networking, communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Strong leadership and regional business development capabilities.

Luxuryline PR and BRU CHARTERS operate in premium business segments, including luxury public relations, business aviation, private aircraft and helicopter charter services, and high-end client solutions.

We are looking for a highly skilled and result-oriented HR & Talent Acquisition Manager who can build a strong network of experienced professionals, freelance sales executives, business development specialists and industry-specific talent to support our business growth.

* Develop and execute recruitment strategies for both businesses.
* Recruit highly skilled sales professionals, business development executives, corporate salespeople and freelance sales partners.
* Build a recruitment pipeline targeting 100 freelance sales candidates over the agreed hiring period.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, referrals, professional networks and industry contacts.
* Identify experienced candidates with proven sales records and strong client acquisition capabilities.

**2. Industry-Specific Hiring**

For BRU CHARTERS:

* Recruit candidates with experience in business aviation, private jet charter, helicopter charter, corporate travel, luxury travel and aviation sales.
* Target professionals with access to corporate clients, HNIs, travel management companies, charter brokers and event organizers.
* Source suitable candidates for corporate charter enquiries, helicopter charter sales and medical evacuation business development.

For Luxuryline PR:

* Recruit professionals experienced in luxury brand PR, client servicing, corporate partnerships, business development, event management and premium-brand sales.
* Identify candidates with strong networking, communication, presentation and relationship-management skills.

**3. Freelance Sales Network Development**

* Establish a structured freelance recruitment and onboarding process.
* Explain commission structures, performance expectations and contractual terms before onboarding.
* Develop a database of qualified candidates and maintain accurate recruitment records.
* Monitor candidate activation, sales enquiries and recruitment quality.

**4. Screening & Assessment**

* Conduct preliminary interviews and competency-based assessments.
* Verify employment history, relevant experience and professional references where appropriate.
* Assess communication, negotiation, client acquisition and relationship-building skills.
* Prioritize quality, integrity and demonstrable performance over candidate volume.

* Maintain candidate pipelines, interview schedules and recruitment reports.

* Track time-to-hire, recruitment costs, candidate retention and active sales performance.

* Experience recruiting for aviation, luxury travel, PR, hospitality, corporate services or premium B2B businesses will be preferred.
* Strong sourcing skills using LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and direct networking.
* Excellent communication, interviewing, negotiation and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and build a large candidate pipeline.
* Comfortable working with measurable hiring targets and management reports.
* High level of professionalism, confidentiality and ethical recruitment practices.

* Quality and relevance of shortlisted candidates.

Salary or compensation will be based on experience, recruitment expertise and demonstrated results. Performance-linked incentives may be considered against clearly defined and achievable KPIs.

Interested candidates should share their updated CV along with details of their recruitment experience, industries handled, sales-profile hiring experience and major hiring achievements.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineer - CD
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

### **Position Summary**

Harness is seeking a dynamic **Sr Engineering Manager** to lead the charge in building the next generation of innovations in **Continuous Delivery (CD)**. This isn’t just another leadership role—it’s a unique opportunity to design and deliver impactful features that delight customers, drive ARR growth, and strengthen our leadership in the DevOps space.

In this role, you’ll guide a **distributed engineering team** spanning multiple geographies, developing new capabilities on top of our platform. You’ll collaborate closely with customers to address escalations, refine feature requirements, and make strategic product decisions that shape the evolution of our CD offering.

We’re looking for a leader who’s not only strong in **backend technologies (Java, Go)** but also enjoys staying hands-on with code. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, embraces ambiguity, and consistently transforms complex challenges into measurable impact.

If you bring energy, innovation, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences, this is your chance to redefine how enterprises deploy software—and leave your mark on the future of DevOps.

### **About the Role**

* Harness is a **market leader in DevOps**, constantly innovating to deliver cutting-edge features and expand into new deployment areas. As an **Sr Engineering Manager**, you’ll play a pivotal role in advancing this vision—staying closely aligned with our customers, building features that attract new users, and expanding adoption across our existing customer base.
* You’ll collaborate with **exceptional engineers and architects**, driving key technology decisions that power the world-class features distinguishing our product from the competition.
* As a **technical leader**, you’ll champion code quality, performance, and best practices—ensuring that every line of code is robust, scalable, and production-ready. Beyond execution, you’ll shape and evolve our technical vision, define forward-looking roadmaps, and inspire your team to innovate and push boundaries.
* This role isn’t just about managing a team—it’s about building a **world-class product** that strengthens our position as a leader in the DevOps market.
  

**About you**

* **Experience:** 10-15 years of overall software development experience, with at least 2–3 years in a formal engineering management or solid tech-lead capacity managing high-performing backend teams.

* Proven Leader: 5+ years leading high-performing engineering teams, balancing technical depth with people leadership.
* Builder’s Mindset: 5+ years building SaaS applications in backend (Java/Go) roles, with a passion for hands-on architecture and coding.
* Organization Builder: A track record of assembling and scaling world-class engineering orgs.
* Global Collaborator: Comfortable leading teams and working with customers across time zones.
* Customer-Obsessed: You’ve directly influenced customer satisfaction and know what it takes to deliver mission-critical, customer-facing software.
* Performance-Driven: Skilled in building multi-tenant SAAS platforms that deliver seamless user experiences.
* Battle-Tested: Strong command of managing production incidents and leading effective on-call rotations.
* Strong knowledge of monitoring, alerting, logging and Performance optimization in large-scale systems.
* Hands-on experience in various Cloud Platforms or Kubernetes is highly desirable
Technically Grounded: BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
